intro: Kravel Koalbeard trusts you to get a job done and to keep quiet about it. He has a new scheme, risky but with the promise of a bundle for you both. You carry his letter to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. This follows Rumors for Kravel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you're an adventurer I can trust, both to get the job done and to keep your mouth shut while doing it.
I've been brewing up a new scheme. It's risky, but if it works then we could both make a bundle! And I think you're just the person to see it through.
To start, you must go back to Booty Bay. I apologize, good friend. I know my last task took you there. But this time, speak with Crank Fizzlebub.
Give him this letter. And if he requires aid, do your best to help him. It will be worth the effort.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello hello. And what brings a noble traveler such as you down to Booty Bay?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I see. Kravel has a big scheme planned. He has a sinister mind -- I like that about him.
So you'll need something to addle wits, eh? Something powerful...
I wonder if the mixture Zanzil feeds his zombies could be used...

related.n: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
